name: Blixeprodil
summary: Blixeprodil (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known by its developmental code name GM-1020 or as (R)-4-fluorodeschloroketamine ((R)-4-FDCK), is an NMDA receptor antagonist related to ketamine which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, bipolar depression, and other depressive disorders. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: Blixeprodil acts as an non-competitive NMDA receptor antagonist (Ki = 3,250 nM) and is a close analogue of ketamine. It shows antidepressant-like effects in rodents. The drug appears to have a greater separation between antidepressant-like and ataxia-inducing doses than ketamine in rodents and hence might have better tolerability in humans.

uses.text: Blixeprodil (INN), also known by its developmental code name GM-1020 or as (R)-4-fluorodeschloroketamine ((R)-4-FDCK), is an NMDA receptor antagonist related to ketamine which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, bipolar depression, and other depressive disorders.

sideEffects.en: It is still investigational, so its effects in people are not fully known. Drugs of its class, the NMDA receptor antagonists, can cause dissociation, confusion, dizziness, nausea and raised blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 它仍在研究階段，因此對人體的影響尚未完全清楚。同類的 NMDA 受體拮抗劑可能造成解離、混亂、頭暈、噁心與血壓升高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它仍在研究阶段，因此对人体的影响尚未完全清楚。同类的 NMDA 受体拮抗剂可能造成解离、混乱、头晕、恶心与血压升高。

fact.en: It is one mirror image of 4-fluorodeschloroketamine, which is ketamine with its chlorine swapped for fluorine. It is being developed as an antidepressant with less of ketamine's dissociation.
fact.zh: 它是 4-fluorodeschloroketamine 的其中一個鏡像異構物，而後者是把氯胺酮的氯換成氟的產物。它正被開發為解離作用較少的抗憂鬱藥。
fact.zhHans: 它是 4-fluorodeschloroketamine 的其中一个镜像异构物，而后者是把氯胺酮的氯换成氟的产物。它正被开发为解离作用较少的抗忧郁药。
